record.title: DfCM lawful frontier
record.body: R68 materially expands the reachable frontier with autonomic run-closure observability while preserving prior consumer-independence, receipt-assimilation, and replication alternatives. Newly reachable lawful fronts: (1) project-memory request/receipt lifecycle -> R68 RDF/OCEL process-event adapter; (2) cross-cell deployment of exact run/checkpoint evidence to MEASURE/EXPLORE/SELECT/IMPLEMENT/PORTFOLIO; (3) scheduler/qualification policies driven by observed queue pressure and exact-head churn; (4) failure-to-opportunity conversion calibration; (5) independent ground-truth calibration for stalled-vs-closed run classification. Weakest multiplier after R68 remains independent portfolio reuse/downstream realization, not producer sensor count. Current marketplace merged subject=0377678f4741aadd5a40c5729ed016e163e3d4b2. 1000X NOT_ADMITTED.
